run_crystal_structure_relaxation: run crystal structure relaxation on CIF files using the UMA ML potential with a YAML config file
create_calculator: create a FAIRChemCalculator with a pretrained UMA model for structure relaxation using the specified calculator config
relax_atoms: relax a single ASE Atoms crystal structure using BFGS, FIRE, or LBFGS with optional cell relaxation and symmetry constraints
relax_atoms_batch: relax multiple crystal structures in batch mode using FairchemLBFGS with optional unit cell optimization
run_relax_jobs: submit parallel SLURM jobs to relax crystal structures from parquet files using submitit AutoExecutor
